scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT,NLP" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:nlp"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client && npm run test:nlp
